name: Unnecessary Convincing
source:
You are chased down by monsters during the night while you felt whimsy going out without thinking much. To make matters worse, you even end up bumping into one.

Now you have to find a way to convince the monster not to eat you. 

I mean, what other tactics do you have?

[Edited from [url=https://k1ra-san.itch.io/unnecessary-convincing]itch.io[/url]]
